description: QA & Feature Discovery toolkit for PocketUICore - Minecraft Fabric 1.21.11

mods.name: PocketUI Test Suite
mods.description: QA & Feature Discovery toolkit for PocketUICore — exercises all components, animations, and renderers to identify bugs and improvement opportunities.

releases.notes:
Initial release — QA & Feature Discovery toolkit for PocketUICore v1.11.0.

**Features:**
- 4-tab interactive test suite (Components, Animations, Rendering, Diagnostics)
- 10 automated tests (all PASS)
- 15 feature improvement suggestions for PocketUICore
- Press U to open, 1-4 for tabs, ESC to close

**Requirements:**
- Minecraft 1.21.11 + Fabric Loader 0.18+ + Fabric API
- PocketUICore >= 1.0.0
- Java 21
